label: Ultralight mass

attrs.description: The assumption that the dark matter particle is extremely light (around 10⁻²² eV), so its de Broglie wavelength reaches galactic scales.

review: Was the assumption "ultralight mass" on relation e66 (Wave Dark Matter exhibits Interference) until 2026-10, when assumptions became concepts; it's now in the "assumes" of Wave Dark Matter, the relation's source.
